les: Die goud in die klip word 'n ring

items.bewering: Goud is 'n natuurlike hulpbron, en in Suid-Afrika kom baie daarvan uit klip diep onder die grond.
items.bron: Harmony, operations/south-africa (nine deep-level mines in the Witwatersrand Basin; 93% of FY09 production underground, har.co.za/09/sa.htm); LBMA Alchemist issue 11 'South Africa's gold mining challenge' (SA costs tied to the deep-level underground nature of local mining); NWU repository dissertations on Mponeng at 3.68 km depth.

items.bewering: Die klip met die goud in vorm 'n dun laag wat myners 'n rif noem.
items.bron: American Geosciences Institute IGC abstract 179 (deep mining targets narrow reefs, often under 1 m); Wits WIReDSpace Middelvlei Reef study (thin auriferous quartz-pebble conglomerate beds called reefs; Carbon Leader Reef about 1 cm thick in places).

items.bewering: Daardie rif loop onder dele van die Vrystaat, Noord-Wes, Gauteng en by Evander in Mpumalanga.
items.bron: AGI IGC abstract 711 (May Reef, Winkelhaak Mine, Evander Goldfield; Commonage Reef, Klerksdorp Goldfield); miningdataonline (Moab Khotsong in the Klerksdorp Goldfield on the western margin of the Witwatersrand Basin, North West); DRDGOLD/Ergo and FWGR on the Central, East and West Rand (Gauteng); Avgold Target, Free State goldfield (Fluor project page).

items.bewering: Verder oos is daar ook goudmyne rondom Barberton.
items.bron: Pan African Resources, 'Gold Mining in Barberton' (Fairview, Sheba and New Consort underground mines in the Barberton Greenstone Belt, Mpumalanga); Mining Weekly / Engineering News mine profiles of Sheba and Fairview, May 2025. Barberton lies east of Evander.

items.bewering: Party goud word weer uit ou mynhope gehaal.
items.bron: Engineering News / Mining Weekly, 'Tailings retreatment, land restoration intertwined', 30 March 2026 (DRDGOLD's Ergo and FWGR reprocess old Witwatersrand dumps and slimes dams for gold); Pan African Resources Mintails near Krugersdorp.

items.bewering: Elders word baie goud in groot oop groewe gemyn.
items.bron: LBMA Alchemist issue 11, 'South Africa's gold mining challenge': 'outside of South Africa, a significant percentage of gold is produced from low-cost open cast mining operations'. Harmony operations page: its only open pit is Kalgold in North West; underground supplied 93% of its production (2009 annual report). Muruntau (Uzbekistan) and Carlin (Nevada) are among the world's largest gold mines and are open-pit or mixed (mining.com, mining-technology.com).
items.regstelling: The claim is true of the world and false of South Africa, and the sentence does not say which it means. Every other sentence in the block is about South Africa, so 'Elders' reads as 'elsewhere in South Africa', where very little gold comes from big open pits; only one small open-pit operation (Kalgold) turned up. Say where 'elsewhere' is, for example 'In ander lande word baie goud in groot oop groewe gemyn'. Do not soften it to 'party' or cut the contrast. With the country named, the claim as written is supported.

items.bewering: Myners breek die klip los en masjiene bring dit na bo.
items.blok: Van die klip tot 'n suiwer staaf
items.bron: Harmony Mponeng cyanide-code audit summary 2023 (cyanidecode.org): ore storage and transport from the mine to the plant; Harmony operations page (deep-level underground shaft mines).

items.bewering: By die myn maal groot meule die klip tot fyn poeier.
items.blok: Van die klip tot 'n suiwer staaf
items.bron: Harmony Mponeng audit summary 2023 (three run-of-mine SAG mills in closed circuit with hydrocyclones at the mine plant); Harmony One Plant and FG1 audit summaries (milling sections, six ROM mills); Driefontein metallurgical plant (rod and pebble milling).

items.bewering: Daarna skei werkers die goud van die klip af.
items.blok: Van die klip tot 'n suiwer staaf
items.bron: Mponeng, Harmony One and Evander plant audit summaries (cyanidecode.org): leaching, carbon-in-pulp adsorption and elution or zinc precipitation separate the gold from the milled rock at the mine.

items.bewering: Die goud word gesmelt en in 'n doré-staaf gegiet, wat nog ru goud is.
items.blok: Van die klip tot 'n suiwer staaf
items.bron: Mponeng audit summary (smelt house; poured bars weighed, labelled and sent to Rand Refinery); Wikipedia 'Doré bar' and StoneX Bullion 'What is gold doré' (a semi-pure alloy of gold and silver, made at or near the mine, not bullion, still to be refined); Financial Mail 2021 (Rand Refinery's doré averages 50-70% gold).

items.bewering: In 'n suiweringswerk word die ander metale uitgehaal tot die goud suiwer is.
items.blok: Van die klip tot 'n suiwer staaf
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rand Refinery' and BullionStar Gold University 'Rand Refinery' (refines mine doré; Kilo 9999 bars); Wikipedia 'Doré bar' (silver and base metals removed, refined to 999.9 purity).

items.bewering: Nie al die goud word juweliersware nie. Lande koop en verkoop goud ook as suiwer stawe en Suid-Afrika voer sulke stawe uit.
items.blok: Van die klip tot 'n suiwer staaf
items.bron: World Gold Council via Kitco, 4 February 2026 (central banks bought a reported 328 t net in 2025); BullionStar, Rand Refinery (largest maker of 400 oz London Good Delivery bars, held by many central banks; LBMA-accredited); World Bank WITS South Africa trade summary 2020 (gold is South Africa's top export product by value).

items.bewering: 'n Juwelier koop van die suiwer goud en smelt dit gewoonlik saam met ander metaal. Dit maak die goud sterker.
items.bron: Corti, 'Metallurgy of microalloyed 24K golds', Santa Fe Symposium 1999 (99.0-99.5% gold is too soft for jewellery; 22ct and 18ct alloys are much harder); World Gold Council assay page gold.org (caratage: 18ct is 75% gold alloyed with copper or silver); Springer abstract on pure gold's low yield point and wear.

items.bewering: Die meeste goue ringe is daarom nie suiwer goud nie.
items.bron: Mintek paper cited in the Corti/Ganoksin material: Europe mostly uses 8-18 carat alloys and the USA mostly 14ct, while India, the Middle East and Southeast Asia use 21-24ct; even 22ct is 91.7% gold. Pure 24ct (chuk kam) is too soft to hold a stone (Corti 1999). The claim is about most rings, not all, and that holds.

items.bewering: Dan vorm sy die metaal tot 'n ring en sit klein stene daarin vas. Sy poleer die ring tot dit blink en stuur dit na 'n winkel.
items.bron: Vocabulary.com, 'jewelry' (made of precious metals and set with gems); Corti 1999 (the setting must grip the stone, which is why the metal is hardened). The sentence describes this one ring, not every ring, so it does not claim that all rings carry stones.

items.bewering: Baie klip lewer net 'n klein bietjie goud. Die klip self is nie veel werd nie.
items.blok: Die waarde klim by elke stap
items.bron: Harmony Form 6-K, FY2026 results (SEC EDGAR): underground recovered grade 5.83 g/t, i.e. under 6 grams of gold per tonne of rock; Sibanye executive quoted on Johannesburg dumps: 'the processing volumes are enormous' for very dilute gold (IOL Business Report).

items.bewering: Sodra die goud by die myn van die klip geskei is, is dit baie meer werd.
items.blok: Die waarde klim by elke stap
items.bron: Follows from the grade above (about 5-6 g of gold spread through 1 000 kg of rock) and from doré being sold to a refinery against its gold content (StoneX 'What is gold doré'; Rio Times on refiners' doré terms, 2026).

items.bewering: 'n Suiwer staaf is weer meer werd as 'n doré-staaf.
items.blok: Die waarde klim by elke stap
items.bron: Rio Times, 'Ghana GoldBod local refining rule 2026' (a refiner charges about 0.30% of the fine gold value to refine doré; the mine is paid for the fine gold less this charge); Wikipedia 'Doré bar' (doré is not bullion and must be refined before it can be sold as investment-grade gold). True, but for the same amount of gold this step adds only a small amount, much less than mining or making jewellery does. 'weer meer werd' does not overstate it.

items.bewering: Dieselfde goud is die meeste werd wanneer dit 'n klaar ring in die winkel is.
items.blok: Die waarde klim by elke stap
items.bron: sootoday.com, 'From the mine to your jewellery box: pricing gold is a complex process' and juvetti.com jewellery pricing guide (retail price = metal value + making charge + retailer overheads and margin, so it is above the metal's value); a jeweller's resale offer is based on metal content alone. 'in die winkel' correctly limits this to the shop price.

items.bewering: Diep grawe en lang tonnels. / Masjiene, krag en baie water. / Die mynwerkers se lone en hulle veiligheid onder die grond. / Vervoer van die klip en die goud. / Die suiweringswerk se masjiene en werkers. / Die juwelier se kundigheid, gereedskap en winkel.
items.blok: Wat die goud se pad kos
items.bron: Mining Journal on Sibanye-Stillwater (labour 49% and electricity 20% of gold operating costs); NWU repository dissertations (deep mines' chilled water, refrigeration and pumping are a major cost; Mponeng makes about 5 000 t of ice a day for cooling); Mponeng audit summary (ore storage and transport); jewellery pricing sources above (labour, tools, retail overheads). Six items checked one by one; none is false.

items.bewering: Van die myn tot die winkel wil elkeen 'n prys kry wat sy koste dek en wins insluit.
items.blok: Waar die wins die opvallendste is
items.bron: sootoday.com and juvetti.com pricing guides (retailers price to cover rent, insurance and salaries plus a margin); Minerals Council position that producers must cover all-in costs (Business Day, 11 July 2018).

items.bewering: 'n Myn verkoop teen die wêreld se goudprys, wat nie altyd sy koste dek nie.
items.blok: Waar die wins die opvallendste is
items.bron: Business Day, 11 and 19 July 2018: Minerals Council said 75% of South African gold mines were unprofitable and that over 80% of companies did not cover costs at the spot price (chief economist Henk Langenhoven). Daily Investor quoting analyst Peter Major: South Africa is a price taker. Mining.com and BusinessLive 2017 (AngloGold's Kopanang and TauTona loss-making at all-in costs above the gold price). Langenhoven also noted that some producers hedge rather than sell at spot; this does not falsify a Grade 6 statement that the price is set by the world market.

items.bewering: Die mynwerkers se loon is een van die myn se koste en nie 'n deel van die wins nie.
items.blok: Waar die wins die opvallendste is
items.bron: Mining Journal (Sibanye: labour 49% of gold operating costs); Mining-Technology 2018 ('labour costs make up 53% of expenses in gold mining operations'). Wages are an operating expense, deducted before profit.

items.bewering: Wanneer die goudprys hoog is, kan die mynmaatskappye groot winste maak.
items.blok: Waar die wins die opvallendste is
items.bron: Gold Fields Form 20-F FY2025 (SEC EDGAR): headline earnings up 117% to US$2 576 m because of higher realised gold prices; Mining Weekly 19 February 2026; Business Day 6 February 2026 (gold rose more than 65% in 2025).

items.bewering: Waar die wins die grootste is, verskil van jaar tot jaar.
items.blok: Waar die wins die opvallendste is
items.bron: The same companies were loss-making in 2016-2018 (Business Day July 2018; AngloGold 2017) and made record profits in 2025 (Gold Fields 20-F FY2025), while jewellery retail adds its making charge and margin every year (pricing sources above). So mining's share of the profit swings from year to year. The sentence is hedged and makes no ranking that sources contradict.

items.bewering: Kop: 'Waar die wins die opvallendste is'
items.blok: Waar die wins die opvallendste is
items.bron: Checked against its own block: the heading's superlative names no winner, and the block's last sentence says the place varies, which the sources above support. Nothing in the heading is a factual claim beyond that.

items.bewering: goudmyn: 'n Plek waar mense klip met goud in uit die grond haal.
items.bron: Harmony operations page (underground and open-pit gold mines extracting ore); consistent with the Mponeng plant summary (ore taken from the mine to the plant).

items.bewering: rif: Myners se woord vir die dun laag klip waarin die goud sit.
items.bron: AGI IGC abstract 179 and Wits WIReDSpace Middelvlei Reef study (Witwatersrand gold is found in thin conglomerate layers known as reefs).

items.bewering: mynhoop: 'n Hoop fyn klip wat oorbly nadat die meeste goud uitgehaal is.
items.bron: Engineering News, 30 March 2026, and IOL Business Report 'Digging for gold at the rubbish dump' (Johannesburg dumps are tailings from milled ore that still hold dilute gold); UCT OpenUCT 'Repurposing of mine waste: gold tailings in South Africa'. Waste-rock dumps of coarse rock also exist, but the gold retreatment the lesson describes is from tailings, so the definition fits the lesson's use.

items.bewering: oop groef: 'n Myn wat 'n groot oop gat in die grond is.
items.bron: kun.uz / Kitco 2021 on Muruntau (an open pit about 3.3 km long, 2.5 km wide and nearly 600 m deep).

items.bewering: meul: 'n Masjien wat harde dinge tot 'n fyn poeier maal.
items.bron: Mponeng and Harmony One plant audit summaries (SAG, rod and pebble mills grind ore to a fine slurry for leaching).

items.bewering: doré-staaf: 'n Staaf ru goud wat nog gesuiwer moet word.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Doré bar'; StoneX Bullion 'What is gold doré' (semi-pure alloy that must be refined before it is investment-grade).

items.bewering: suiweringswerk: 'n Fabriek waar die ander metale uit ru goud gehaal word.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rand Refinery'; Financial Mail 2021, 'Rand Refinery: making the gold glister' (refiner of doré from mines).

items.bewering: suiwer: Iets is suiwer as niks anders daarby gemeng is nie.
items.bron: BullionStar, Rand Refinery (bars cast from 999.9 pure 24-carat gold). Refined gold has 0.01% left in it, which is negligible at this grade level, and the definition matches how 'pure gold' is used of refined bars.

items.bewering: juweliersware: Dinge soos ringe, kettings en oorbelle wat 'n mens dra.
items.bron: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries, 'jewellery' (objects such as rings and necklaces that people wear as decoration); Vocabulary.com, 'jewellery'. An Afrikaans WAT entry did not turn up in search.

items.bewering: mynmaatskappy: 'n Besigheid wat 'n myn besit en sy werk laat doen.
items.bron: Pan African Resources (company that owns and runs Barberton Mines); Harmony operations page (company that owns and operates nine underground mines).

opsomming: Thirty-five claims checked, including every begrip and lys item: 34 confirmed and one contradicted. Block 'Goud sit vas in klip' says 'Elders word baie goud in groot oop groewe gemyn' in a paragraph that is otherwise all about South Africa, where gold comes almost entirely from deep underground mines and old dumps, so 'elsewhere' must say another country. The four superlatives hold, the lesson has no analogy, and nothing is uncertain.
